description: Registry of all active Jarvis dev sessions. Short IDs match the name field in ORCHESTRATOR_STATUS.json and session_name in WORK_QUEUE.json.

sessions.name: jarvis-board
sessions.purpose: Bug fixes, AGENT_BOARD item closure, baseline suite, freeze lift. Primary conductor lane.
sessions.notes: Coordinates lane dispatch and harvest. Do not modify model_router.py or brain_ollama.py.

sessions.name: jarvis-self-eval
sessions.purpose: Autonomous self-eval scoring loop, /reflect improvements, PreFlect gate, prompt optimizer.
sessions.notes: Writes scores to eval_trace_score. PreFlect is default-off (JARVIS_PREFLECT=1 to enable).

sessions.name: jarvis-local-llm
sessions.purpose: context_budget.py wiring, LOCAL_FIRST routing, model_router.py, cross-session memory persistence.
sessions.notes: GLM 5.2 model-default changes require eval lane findings first. Memory writes go to vault/.

sessions.name: jarvis-audit
sessions.purpose: harness/audit.py improvements, snapshot UI, /restore command, run_id threading, eval_trace_score surface.
sessions.notes: Owns ORCHESTRATOR_STATUS.json writes via harness/audit.py. Do not edit model_router.py.
